title: Content Writer - Marketing
jobDescription:
Our Content Marketing team has a requirement for a Content Writer. Department: Content Writing Job Location: Goregaon, Mumbai Working details: 5 days working
- 9 hours shift KEY

title: Digital Marketing - Unit Lead / Assistant Manager / Manager
jobDescription:
Department: Digital Marketing Job Location: Goregaon (west), Mumbai Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Responsible for generating revenue and achieving growth targets. Work with in-house SEO & PPC teams to track organic traffic performance and paid advertisement. Analyze and design customer acquisition campaigns using web analytics and all ongoing On-Page and Off-Page SEO efforts. Conceptualize and manage all digital marketing campaigns and be on the lookout for innovative customer acquisition and branding opportunities Managing web content and rationalize, optimize, and oversee the structure and content of our regional and global websites. Develop a process to ensure content is topical, relevant, and up-to-date, enabling web visitors a feeling of personalized engagement with the website and its content. Regular usability checks for English and other language websites for maximum localization impact. Build brand awareness and visibility through online press releases, social media including industry-specific articles on blogs and other relevant mediums Work in collaboration with designers to improvise on the existing websites design and develop new websites, revamp online marketing material, and email marketing campaigns. Evaluate and finalize all design-related tasks. Keyskills Online Marketing, Digital Marketing, SEO, PPC, Web Management, Internet Marketing, HTML, Team Management. Pre-requisites/key characteristics and skills required: Proven experience in Digital Marketing. MBA from a reputed institute (preferred) Sound knowledge and hands-on experience in SEO, Organic Marketing, and experience in revenue generation. Curiosity to learn, ambition to progress, creativity to innovate, and the willingness to go that extra mile to achieve unprecedented success. Excellent analytical skills and ability to assess market trends, growth possibilities, and areas of concern. Ability to ideate and engage existing clients and prospective clients through email marketing Excellent verbal and written communication skills Knowledge of using MS Office and the ability to acclimatize to different technical tools used in the organization Knowledge of HTML, Java Script, CSS (added advantage)

title: Digital Marketing Executive
jobDescription:
JOB DESCRIPTION Job Title: Digital Marketing Executive Department: Marketing Job location: Goregaon (west), Mumbai Shift timings: 9am to 6pm Reporting: Sr. Manager
- Marketing Experience: 2+ years of digital marketing experience Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Execute digital marketing and promotion campaigns across relevant digital channels. Build & grow the network by driving outreach programs. Help to execute on-page and off-page SEO strategies (including link building, commenting, SMM). Help in optimizing landing pages and regional marketing pages. Help to contribute to the company blog and other external communications. Competitor Analysis & tracking. Complete weekly and monthly performance & MIS reports. Keep up to date with the latest SEM technology, SEO updates and industry changes Keyskills Online Marketing, Digital Marketing, SEO, Off-page marketing, outbound marketing, Outreach, Pre-requisites/key characteristics and skills required: At least 2 years of hands-on experience in Digital Marketing. Good understanding of non-paid (organic & referral) digital marketing channels. Experience using Google Analytics is necessary. Very Good verbal and written communication skills. Analytical mindset and a go-getter attitude. Knowledge of using MS Office, Canva, and ability to acclimatize to different technical tools used in the organization. Knowledge of HTML and CSS will be an added advantage. title: Email Marketing/ Campaign Management Speicalist
jobDescription:
Job title: Campaign Management / Email Marketing Department: Global, Enago Location: Goregaon West, Mumbai Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design and Implement drip campaigns via Sales CRM (Hub Spot). Reaching out to targeted customers through blast emails, drip campaigns, Linked In & other similar outreach activities. Coordinating and planning for various email-marketing activities for lead generation and existing/potential client engagement activities. Manage the end-to-end process of new landing pages creation for new B2B’s (publishers / universities). Work with relevant regional stakeholders to create an effective engagement plan for existing / new customers. Drafting content for cold emails, follow-ups emails, drip campaign workflow and execution, linked In campaigns for new lead generation. Checking out Email campaign performance and amplify opens & clicks. Maintain competitor knowledge to create and adjust email campaign strategies / engagement activities. Maintain a high level of knowledge regarding Enago’s Services and key product differentiation to enable effective dialogue with customers and to build relationships of trust and value. Reporting Performance, maintaining sales CRM and sharing vital insights on overall campaign / engagement performance. Reporting to the Sales Manager and updating on lead status, ongoing interested situations, and conversations with customers. Understand customer needs and requirements. Coordinate with other teams to provide excellent service to customer in terms of B2B marketing engagement initiatives. Coordinating with the Marketing, EA, CS teams for various customer engagement activities / promotional campaigns etc. Achieve monthly & quarterly quotas for E-Meetings. Skills Required: Experience in drip campaign management and digital marketing engagement activities. Knowledge of email marketing and social selling. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite and sales CRM such as Hub Spot. Excellent verbal and written communication skills Willingness to research, understand the market and help acquire new business via various activities. Excellent Negotiation skills, Relationship building, Target and Revenue driven mindset. Excellent analytical skills and ability to assess market trends, growth possibilities, and areas of concern. To learn more about our company, you may visit our website
- http://www.crimsoni.com/ . For Enago, visit www.enago.com

title: Head Of Marketing - Mumbai
jobDescription:
Exciting Opportunity in Crimson Interactive! About Us: Crimson Interactive is an ISO-certified organization (ISO 9001:2008) providing Japanese and English language solutions to customers globally. Our brands deliver services in three professional areas: Translation (www.ulatus.jp) Editing (www.enago.jp) Transcription (www.voxtab.jp) In addition, we have a strong corporate presence in Japan (http://www.crimsonjapan.co.jp/). We have served more than 15,000 clients and are proud to be amongst the top three editing companies in Japan. Since our inception in 2005, we have moved from strength to strength and now have a team of several hundred translators operating all across the globe. We have also successfully partnered with Japan’s largest academic publisher, Maruzen, and the second largest publisher in the world, Dai Nippon Publishing (DNP), for their editorial and translation needs. Crimson is a company where cultures across boundaries thrive together. We have Japanese, Chinese, Taiwanese, and Indians working for a common objective. We have clients in various geographies-Japan, China, Taiwan, Germany, Korea, the US, UK, etc. Honors and Awards: Crimson has been recognized among the 100 most promising companies in the world by Red Herring Awards (http://herringevents.com/rhg2010/winners/2010winners.html). The top 100 winners were the most promising companies in the Asia-Pacific (APAC) business region for leading innovation through technological revolution and creative adaption. Crimson stood out in the academic editing, transcription, and language solutions domain and was a clear winner as compared with its closest competitors. In an environment of diverse cultures, we encourage open communication in all forms and meanings. Always looking for the “intelligent” way of doing things, we encourage fresh ideas and learning initiatives. We believe in forming minds and personalities. While the older employees have set the culture, the newer ones redefine it every day, keeping the dynamism alive. Crimson is, in short, defined by Quality People! Quality Work! We provide language solutions to over 2 million authors from 125 countries across our three brands
- Enago, Ulatus & Voxtab. We are headquartered in Mumbai & have global offices in New York, New Jersey, Beijing, Seoul & Tokyo. Our client list includes Netflix, Sony, Toyota, MIT, Capgemini, Guinness World Records, Hitachi, and Fujitsu. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Responsible for generating revenue and achieving growth targets. Work with in-house SEO & PPC teams to track organic traffic performance and paid advertisement. Analyze and design customer acquisition campaigns using web analytics and all ongoing On-Page and Off-Page SEO efforts. Conceptualize and manage all digital marketing campaigns and be on the lookout for innovative customer acquisition and branding opportunities Managing web content and rationalize, optimize, and oversee the structure and content of our regional and global websites. Develop a process to ensure content is topical, relevant, and up-to-date, enabling web visitors a feeling of personalized engagement with the website and its content. title: Sr Executive - Digital Marketing
jobDescription:
Role Summary: Digital Marketing- Sr. Executive Digital marketing executives oversee the online marketing strategy for the organization. They plan and execute marketing campaigns and designs that promote a company’s brand and maintain & supply content for the organization’s website. In addition, they engage with the public through social media and ensure visitor flow to digital sites. Digital marketing executives analyze and report on visitor data and devise new ways to market products. What would the work Entail: Plan and execute all web, SEO/SEM, database marketing, email, social media, and display advertising campaigns Building and maintaining the company’s social media presence Measure and report performance of all digital marketing campaigns and assesses against goals (ROI and KPIs) Identify trends and insights and optimize spending and performance based on the insights. Brainstorm new and creative growth strategies through digital marketing Plan and execute measured experiments and improve conversion rates Collaborate with internal teams to create landing pages and optimize the user experience Utilize strong analytical ability to evaluate end-to-end customer experience across multiple channels and customer touchpoints Identify critical conversion points and drop-off points and optimize user funnels Collaborate with agencies and other vendor partners for relevant campaigns Update & evaluate emerging technologies and its implementation. Provides thought leadership and perspective for adoption where appropriate Creating and participating in content ideas. Implement strategies to build organic & inorganic Track marketing performance and return on investment and maintain daily, weekly and monthly reports for management. Make reports on competition and their analysis. Source advertising opportunities and place adverts in the press or on the radio or on the social media Work closely with in-house or external creative agencies to design marketing materials such as brochures and adverts Write and proofread marketing copy for both online and print campaigns Produce creative content, including videos and blog posts Arrange the effective distribution of marketing material. Conduct market research, for example, using customer questionnaires and surveys Your Attributes: Minimum 4 years of proven working experience in digital marketing · Excellent communication and interpersonal skills Experience in B2C & B2B social media paid campaigns, Google Adwords and email campaigns and SEO\SEM, and market research Demonstrable experience leading and managing SEO/SEM, marketing database, email, social media, and/or display advertising campaigns Highly creative with experience in identifying target audiences and devising digital campaigns that engage, inform, and motivate Experience in optimizing landing pages and user funnels Solid knowledge of website analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Web-Trends) Strong analytical skills and data-driven thinking Up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices in online marketing and measurement Working knowledge of ad serving tools Careers Careers Home Life@Crimson About us Services Contact us Marketing Sr Executive

title: Sr Manager - Marketing - Mumbai
jobDescription:
Please find below the Job Profile and the Company details: https://www.crimsoni.com/ CRIMSON is looking for entrepreneurial-minded Digital Marketing Champions who like to work in a fast-paced, dynamic, and high-performance work atmosphere. We are expanding aggressively and looking for multiple Senior roles. If you love to work independently, push the boundaries, and want to make your presence felt, this is the role for you. You will be responsible for P&L and will have revenue as your KPI. Technology plays a major role in our company and we work on personalization tools and use artificial intelligence to meet your marketing goals. We have a digital marketing team of more than 50 members covering various specialties like PPC, SEO, social media marketing, content, website management, etc. The team has members from various nationalities and they work together as one team to build strategies and execute them. This is an opportunity to work with one of the most progressive, energetic, experienced & fun marketing teams in the industry. These are the game changers, the visionaries who also roll up their sleeves & get stuff done! A culture that is easily one of the best in the industry & continues to attract top talent to work with us globally. This will not only give you multiple chances to interact with Crimsonites in other countries but also experience their hospitality and culture when you visit our offshore offices. The various areas of your work would include: STRATEGY: Develop the digital marketing strategy to meet business objectives Execute the strategic planning rhythm to ensure follow-through of the functional deliverables via discussions, updates, and action-tracking Work closely with business and product heads to understand the client’s needs and do client interviews Develop a deep understanding of the market and competition landscape PERFORMANCE MARKETING: Manage all digital marketing assets Plan and execute a plethora of digital marketing activities, including SEO/SEM, Social Media Marketing, marketing database, emails, and display advertising campaigns etc. Measure, report, and present performances of all digital marketing campaigns Utilize the strong analytical ability to evaluate end-to-end customer experience across multiple channels and customer touch points. Responsible for Optimizing web traffic and performance metrics such as CTR, engagement, lead generation, conversion, site ranking, and open rates/opt-outs Monitor progress and lead performance governance meet. PEOPLE IMPACT: Be a role model for your team of marketers and mentor/coach them to be Marketing Champions Influence a high-performance company culture by challenging critical business assumptions and encouraging cross-functional collaboration Driving a culture of innovation in marketing and communication Forecast hiring needs for the Marketing team WHAT WILL HELP YOU SUCCEED IN THIS

title: Manager - B2B/Enterprise Sales - Crimson AI
jobDescription:
JOB DESCRIPTION Job Title: Assistant Sales Manager / Sales Manager [B2B / Enterprise Sales] Department: Marketing Job location: Goregaon (west), Mumbai Shift timings: 9am to 6pm Reporting: Sr. Manager
- Marketing Crimson AI is looking for a SAAS Sales Manager to establish and drive B2B/Enterprise sales activities for our software products worldwide. As part of your responsibilities, you will penetrate and prospect named accounts for new business and establish new prospects. We are a software development company that builds web applications for authors and researchers in the STEM industry. Trinka.ai and Raxter.io are among its flagship products. Key Responsibilities include but are not limited to: Responsible for generating revenue and achieving the growth targets via prospecting, qualifying, selling and closing enterprise client accounts worldwide. Managing perspective client relationships through all phases of the sales cycle Providing a consultative solutions sales process to prospects
- conducting one-on-one and group sales presentations / product demos. Build and maintain C-Level relationships Nurture the prospective clients / leads on industry trends and innovative solutions for the key challenges across the ecosystem Liaise with cross-function teams to ensure content is topical, relevant, and up-to-date, enabling web visitors a feeling of personalized engagement with the website and its content. Partner with Marketing colleagues on driving cross-functional, cross-channel marketing efforts to grow the lead funnel and meet the growth objectives Pro-actively track competitor movements in the market. Key Skills Saa S sales, Enterprise sales, B2B software sales, lead nurturing, excellent communication & presentation skills, Email marketing, Team Management. Key Requirements and characteristics: Minimum 5-8 years of hands-on experience selling On-Demand, Saa S (Software as a Service) solution or subscription based product to a diverse customer base of B2Bs/Enterprises. Graduate from a reputed institute. MBA preferred, but not mandatory. Proven track record of acquiring clients
- from prospecting to closing. Ability to adapt, overcome objections, and learn complex solutions Excellent analytical skills and ability to assess market trends, growth possibilities, and areas of concern. Ability to ideate and engage existing and prospective clients through email marketing Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Knowledge of using MS Office and ability to acclimatize to different technical tools used in the organization Perks & Benefits Work with a highly energetic and diverse global team. Exposure build connections with a diverse clientele worldwide Quarterly and annual team parties and outings Flexible working hours Flat hierarchy and open door policy… and much more. title: Associate Product Manager/ Product Manager
jobDescription:
APM/PM for Trinka AI About Trinka AI and Crimson Interactive At Trinka AI, we are building a world-class product to help millions of students, academics, researchers, and professionals to write better. Trinka is just a year old and is well on its course to rival the likes of Grammarly. Within a year of launch, Trinka has already garnered 110,000 users worldwide. Trinka was developed by a passionate team of linguists, data scientists, engineers, and product folks. The team has a history of charting unexplored territories and believes in building what would be of real value to the users. Trinka AI is a part of the Enago/Crimson Interactive Group, a multi-national company with 15 years of global experience. Crimson has a presence in 120 countries with 200k+ clients, 600 employees, 5000 contractors, and 10 international offices located in Tokyo, Beijing, Seoul, New Jersey, London, and so forth. We are looking for an experienced Associate Product Manager/Product Manager to help us build new products/features, from ideation to launch. We need someone with a keen interest in developing delightful user experiences and experience working with and guiding UX and UI designers. Responsibilities Work with senior product management and other stakeholders to gather requirements and scope solutions. You will have to develop and then leverage your user and business understanding to contribute to creating a roadmap that will put the product ahead of the competition. Work with the UX/UI, development, and QA colleagues to help prioritize the implementation of new features/enhancements and set specific timelines. You will have to be the voice of both the user and the business for these teams. Participate in the UX/UI design process to guide teams towards the objective and ensure designing the best user experience. Our users are academics and professionals with unique needs. Your outlook of user experience might be challenged, but you will get support in developing an understanding our users. Work with the development teams to deliver functional solutions that offer delightful experiences and are delivered on time. You will need to develop an understanding of our competitors and users to achieve this. Participate in and oversee the quality assurance process for each release to ensure delivery quality
- be it helping QA teams with test cases or conducting the final tests yourself. Contribute in devising appropriate success metrics for features. Analyze user behavior to understand product/feature success. Groom the backlog basis user feedback and inputs from other sources. Experience working with product management tools would be beneficial. Create support and training documents for internal and external users, as required. Help marketing and sales teams by participating in creation of collaterals and other relevant documents. Experience requirements Previous work experience as an Associate Product Manager or a Product Manager for 23 years with a focus on UX. However, we value talent and passion more than the years of experience. Candidates with experience building a product from scratch please do apply even if you do not meet the experience criterion. Candidates with a good understanding of design thinking would be preferred. Experience working with UX/UI teams and hands-on experience with wireframing/mock up tools, such as Figma, Balsamiq. Thorough understanding of prioritization frameworks and the importance of detailed product and functional requirement documents. Good understanding of web technologies and experience working with development teams across development stages. Behavioral/attitude requirements Passion for continuous learning and unlearning. Love for product management and innate ownership for your products. Ability to question the status quo and enthusiasm towards finding answers in/through data. Taking feedback constructively and identifying improvement opportunities in feedback. Strong time management skills. You might need to switch between projects often. Good communication skills along with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams. title: Backend Fullstack Developer - Crimson Interactive
jobDescription:

Crimson has presence in 120+ countries with 200k+ clients, 600 employees, 5000 contractors, and 10 international offices located in Tokyo, Beijing, Seoul, New Jersey, London, and so forth. Crimson AI, our AI products division, is a diverse team of motivated, curious data scientists, engineers, linguists, software quality experts, product management professionals, and marketing ninjas. The team has a history of charting unexplored territories and believes in building what would be of real value to the users. Our products, Trinka (www.trinka.ai) and RAx (www.raxter.io) serve a global userbase and help them in their academic pursuits through. Our products also help the largest academic publishers in the world achieve cost and process efficiencies. Trinka (www.trinka.ai) helps writers write better. Trinka was the first product designed for academic and to It is like Grammarly for formal and academic writing, and then some more. Trinka uses cutting-edge deep learning techniques, language models, NLP, expert systems to find out errors and correct them. It also lets authors find out where to publish and see how ready they are to publish. RAx (https://raxter.io) is the first smart workspace that helps researchers (students, professors, corporate researchers) to be better and faster in their research projects. Powered with proprietary AI algorithms and a unique approach to solving problems with design and tech, RAx is set to be the default workspace for any research-heavy projects. Launched in 2019, the product connects information (Research papers, Blogs, Wiki, Books, Courses, Videos, etc.) to behaviors (reading, writing, annotating, discussing & more), opening up newer insights and opportunities in the academic space that was otherwise not possible (or not imaginable). About the team Backend Full Stack Developer 2 We are a bunch of passionate researchers, engineers, and designers who came together to build a product that can revolutionize the way any research-intensive projects are done. Reducing cognitive load and helping people to convert information into knowledge, is at the core of our mission. Our engineering team is building a scalable platform that deals with tons of data, AI processing over the data, and interactions of users from across the globe. We believe research plays a key role in making the world a better place, and we want to make it easy to approach and fun to do! We are growing and are looking to expand our team with some Rockstar engineers. We are looking for an experienced Java Full Stack developer to help us enhance the product, ensure we scale seamlessly to grow and serve a global userbase of several millions, and venture into newer business avenues with our product/technology. Role overview We are looking for a Rockstar Full Stack Engineer with experience in building high-performing, scalable, enterprise-grade applications with hands-on knowledge on Java (React/Angular + Strong Java with micro-services & REST API + any DB). Professional profile we are looking for Must have About 3-5 years of experience in developing scalable enterprise level applications as a Java Full Stack Developer ( version 1.8 or higher ). Strong experience with the Spring boot framework. Solid understanding of the Java Concurrency Utilities framework. Knowledge of any front end framework (i.e Angular/React/Vue) is a must. Bonus Experience with Apache Kafka, AWS Cloud, Python, Django. Backend Full Stack Developer 3 Behavioral traits that will help you succeed in this role
1. Collaborative
- We are a tight team and need to move fast!
2. Communicative
- We are solving some really niche and complex problems. Communication is key. This also means good documentation.
3. Analytical
- Our product is quite complex. Critical thinking is a must for you to succeed.
4. Growth-oriented
- If you focus on your growth diligently, the product will get better for sure :) What will you get
1. Opportunity to build and enhance super-challenging products that serve a global userbase.
2. Opportunity to scale your product to millions of users!
3. An interesting bunch of people to work with.
4. A chance to shape the future team for the product/organization. To know more about us, please visit www.crimsoni.ai, www.trinka.ai

title: Data Engineer
jobDescription:
We are building a world-class language-related product that has the potential to positively transform lives worldwide. We have a passionate team of data scientists, coders, and linguists who have been working on it. We are looking for a Data Engineer who will identify and implement the best data-driven methodologies considering the product requirements. Work location: Goregaon (West), Mumbai Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Create, build and design data management systems across an entire organization Work with very large data sets (both structured and unstructured). Help data scientist to easily retrieve the needed data for their evaluations and experiments. Design, develop and implement R&D and pre-product prototype solutions Must have strong engineering skills that will help engineering team to productivize NLP/ML algorithms Implement scalable, maintainable, well documented and high-quality solutions. Interested candidates, please apply immediately.

title: Head of Engineering - Crimson Interactive
jobDescription:
Job title: Head Of Engineering Department: IT Experience: 10 to 17 years Location: Goregaon West, Mumbai Overview We are a team of passionate data scientists, engineers, and linguists, who were stymied by the paucity of good automation software in the scholarly publishing industry. So we decided to make our own AI-powered products driven by natural language processing and machine learning to help both authors and publishers in the daunting task of manuscript publication. Our products target, and thereby ease the human burden, at every stage of the publication cycle, from manuscript writing to knowledge dissemination. Website http://https://www.trinka.ai/ Job Description: Enago flagship products At Enago we are laser-focused on building AI-powered tools and services that significantly boost the productivity of researchers and professionals. Every researcher or professional goes through the stages of knowledge discovery, knowledge acquisition, knowledge creation, and knowledge dissemination. However, each stage is cognitively heavy and is tightly coupled. In this direction, we have our flagship products Trinka and RAx that focus on making all these four stages easy and fast. About Enago Trinka Trinka ( www.trinka.ai ) is an AI-powered English grammar checker and language enhancement writing assistant designed for academic and technical writing. Built by linguists, scientists, and language lovers, Trinka finds and corrects thousands of complex writing errors
- so you don’t have to. Trinka corrects contextual spelling mistakes, and advanced grammar errors, enhances vocabulary usage, and provides writing suggestions in real-time. Trinka goes beyond grammar to help professionals and academics ensure professional, concise, and engaging writing. With subject-specific correction, Trinka understands the nuances in the expression of each subject and ensures the writing is fit for the subject. Trinka's Enterprise solutions come with unlimited access and great customization options to all of Trinka’s powerful capabilities. About Enago RAx RAx ( https://raxter.io ) is the first smart workspace that helps researchers (students, professors, corporate researchers, and professionals) to be better and faster in their research projects. Powered with proprietary AI algorithms and a unique approach to solving problems with design and tech, RAx is set to be the default workspace for any research-heavy projects. Launched in 2019, the product connects information (Research papers, Blogs, Wiki, Books, Courses, Videos, etc.) to behaviors (reading, writing, annotating, discussing & more), opening up newer insights and opportunities in the academic space that was otherwise not possible (or not imaginable). About the team We are a bunch of passionate researchers, engineers, and designers who came together to build a product that can revolutionize the way any research-intensive projects are done. Reducing cognitive load and helping people to convert information into knowledge, is at the core of our mission. Our engineering team is building a scalable platform that deals with tons of data, AI processing over the data, and interactions of users from across the globe. We believe research plays a key role in making the world a better place, and we want to make it easy to approach and fun to do! Role overview As the Engineering Head, you will actively lead a team of talented web developers, understand the products (and their use-cases in and out), and work towards a high-quality end-to-end delivery using a pragmatic agile approach based on a dynamic assessment of the evolving situation of a growth-stage startup. You will be working along with the Director Engineer (DE), Technical Project Manager (TPM), Solution Architect (SA), Principal Engineers (PEs), Senior Dev Ops, and a team of highly motivated and enthusiastic developers. You will also be pragmatically ensuring the flexibility of the product and that tech debt doesn’t creep in . In essence, your usual day will be primarily reviewing solution architecture, and approach, and making sure that the best practices of the engineering development lifecycle are in place. You will be the sole person to evaluate the performance of DEs, and in absence of DEs that of the SA, PEs, Dev Ops, and SDE-3 Leads. The person that we are looking for We are seeking an Engineering Head with 8+ years of enterprise backend or full-stack web-dev experience (preferably Vue JS/Angular JS if full-stack, Node JS/Java/Python Django/Fast API with AWS Serverless), 10+ years of solution architecture experience , and 6+ years of engineering management experience . What we would love to see in you: You have excellent skills in understanding the business goals , assessing the ground situation , and coming up with a concrete and detailed plan. You have experience with unit and integration testing, particularly in a Dev Ops environment . You believe in TDD, encourage extensive test coverage and seek to automate testing whenever possible. You will be responsible for designing and conducting a high-quality code-review process and maintaining highly performant, testable code following strong software design patterns . You show remarkable foresight in designing optimized scalable solutions . You enjoy breaking down complex problems into small tasks and PRs to deliver value safely and incrementally. You will be actively reviewing approaches created by tech leads and helping them to find the optimal solutions to the problems. You take pride in estimating project efforts with reasonable accuracy and ensure proactive communication up to and down the chain of command . You will work with the DE, Dev Ops, TPM, SA, and PEs to optimize, update, and maintain cloud infrastructure and associated costs ( AWS ). You will also be continuously collaborating with Research Engineering leads to ensure cross-end scalability. You are very well acquainted with best practices around project deployment and educate the team about the same. You will be evaluating the tech leadership performance (KPI) . You will be designing and overseeing the hiring process making sure that we have a great tech team that has: (a) a high level of curiosity, (b) resourcefulness, (c) solid expertise level, (d) high attention-to-details, (e) superb commitment and reliability, and (f) obsession for amazing user experience. This entails that you will be having a strong network of highly talented senior developers whom you can reach out to and inspire ( in an ethical and professional way ) to join the team and create something that the world has never seen! Experience You have proven 6+ years of technical leadership experience leading high-performant tech senior leadership including Director of Engineering, Solution Architects, Principal Engineers, and Engineering Managers. You have proven 10+ years of cost-efficient, robust, and highly scalable solution architecting experience . You have proven 8+ years of hardcore development experience as either full-stack (Vue Js-Node JS/Angular JS-Java/Python) or backend (Node.js/Java Server technologies/Python Server technologies with advanced Python and highly scalable system engineering experience) You have extensively worked with backend technologies including relational (Postgres/My SQL) and document (Mongo DB) databases, Redis/Memcache; Kafka/Rabbit MQ/Celery/AWS SQS , container orchestration (Docker Compose/Kubernetes), and CI/CD. You have strong experience working with AWS technologies like Lambda functions, SQS, SNS, RDS, Dynamo DB, etc. You have a sound understanding of HTML5, CSS3, CSS processors, and CSS frameworks. You know when to write highly optimized vs highly maintainable code. You have very strong experience in the best practices around developer tooling and workflows. You consider testing, monitoring, and observability first-order priorities . Until your code runs in production and returns the results and metrics you expect, you know your work isn't complete . You have worked on high-impact projects , and you see software engineering as a team sport and like collaborating with fellow engineers, product managers, and others to deliver customer value. You are energized by working in a highly collaborative environment at a user experience-obsessed startup. You have very strong experience in profiling and impact analysis for code being written You are a Root Cause Analysis (RCA) freak. ** Added advantage **: You have experience working with Elasticsearch server cluster optimization and Apache Spark/Ray. You can visit : https://www.trinka.ai/ https://www.crimsoni.ai/ https://raxter.io/ https://www.crimsoni.com/

title: UX Head
jobDescription:
About RAx [RAx]( https://raxter.io ) (RA for Research Assistant) is the first smart workspace that helps researchers (students, professors, corporates) to be better and faster in their research projects. Powered with proprietary A.I algorithms and a unique approach to solving problems with design and tech, RAx is set to be the default workspace for any research-heavy projects. Launched in 2019, the product **connects information** (Research papers, Blogs, Wiki, Books, Courses, Videos, etc.)* **to behaviors** (reading, writing, annotating, discussing & more),* **opening up insights and opportunities** in academic space that was otherwise not possible (or not imaginable). About the team We are a small group of passionate researchers, engineers, and designers who came together to build a product that can revolutionize the way any research-intensive projects are done. Reducing cognitive load and helping people to convert information into knowledge, is at the core of our mission. Our engineering team is building a scalable platform that deals with tons of data, A.I processing over the data and interactions of users from across the globe. We believe research plays a key role in making the world a better place, and we want to make it easy to approach and fun to do! Role Overview As a UX Head, you will help define and optimize the end-to-end product experience vision of RAx, including defining **user research methodologies**, **end-to-end user interaction experience**, **branding strategy**, and **visual communication strategy**. You will also assist the marketing team in **market research**, **campaign design** and **positioning strategy**. You play a key role in helping RAx achieve its vision of building the most effective research workflow for any serious research. You will collaborate across functions of Product, Engineering, Research, Marketing and Customer Success to build features that solve our users’ problems, are delightfully simple to use, and help drive business goals and product growth. With a key focus on solving complex information management and productivity problems using a digital solution. Responsibilities
1. Design world-class holistic product experience strategies (**product engagement**, **customer engagement**, **community building**)
2. Design, execute, and improvise **agile user research methodologies** and **design processes** that scale across our products
3. Design **in-product user growth** strategies
4. Detect retention threats and design **in-product user engagement** strategies
5. Together with the design team, plan user-behavior based and user-feedback based **design revisions**
6. Conduct thorough **UX analysis of competing products/features**
7. Be the **bridge-person** between our Product, Design, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to strategize on product roadmap (new features and iterations), design marketing and promotional campaigns, and support other business requirements
8. Collaborate with a team of 2-3 designers via design reviews, design critique, and design sprint planning Skills & Experience
1. **Strong background in research methodologies** (academic or corporate) with a proven track record of research skills via publications or delivery of research-heavy projects
2. 3-5 years of product/project management experience in researchtech or edtech domain
3. Strong knowledge of User Research methodologies and UX design
4. Good understanding of UI design
5. Great presentation and communication skills to get the team on board with your vision
6. Obsession with users
- who they are and how they use the product
- to create the best experience for them; knowledge of tools like Mixpanel and Amplitude is going to be a huge advantage.
7. Bias for action with a focus on measurable results
- ship high-quality releases, take feedback from users, apply learnings, refine the product, repeat.
8. Experience building products for mobile and web platforms
9. Ability to thrive in startups with fast-paced environment and take ownership for working through ambiguity Additional Advantages:
- A Ph.D. from a reputed university/institute/lab
- Highly networked in academia and corporate research community
- Prior experience in researchtech/edtech/publishing/STM verticle
- Experience working on productivity tools
- A good understanding of how software systems work About the Company: Crimson Interactive Pvt. Ltd. www.crimsoni.com Crimson is best defined as an organization that encourages innovation, employs creativity, and implements invention of nascent yet brilliant ideas, out-of-the-box strategies, and creative renditions of minds that work together to progress steadily. jobDescription:
This involves communicating with potential and existing clients over email to assist in their payments, sending timely invoices, identifying/matching payments, and building relationships with clients. Understand client requirements and solve payment related issues with the assistance of the client servicing team and Japanese colleagues. Pre-requisites/Key characteristics and skills required:- The characteristics/skills that such a person will have to demonstrate are as follows: Technical skills Knowledge of MS Word and Power Point Advanced knowledge of MS Excel Good typing speed Excellent written English skills Abilities Ability to work with numbers comfortably Ability to gain an understanding of external systems related to payments Ability to multi-task without losing focus Ability to prioritize tasks at hand based on the client’s urgency levels Ability to identify and solve potential issues/problem areas that clients may have Ability to suggest service or process improvements Ability to work independently and responsibly with minimum supervision Ability to plan projects and execute them within a strict deadline Ability to meet the team as well as individual deadlines Ability to pre-empt certain concerning the situation and take corrective actions beforehand Ability to research client history well and be well-informed Ability to understand client perspective related to payments and meeting all requests; in turn contributing to an increase in client volume. title: Manuscript Submission Expert (Publication Support)
jobDescription:
Job title: Manuscript Submission Expert Department: Publication Support Location: Goregaon West, Mumbai Working days: 5 days Works with: Publication Support team Role Description: As a submission expert, you’re joining a team of Research Publication Support experts who work with researchers from around the world in communicating the latest innovative research. You find yourself most content in being able to communicate with authors, professors, and universities head. As an expert, you will be responsible for the submission of manuscripts to renowned journals throughout the world and align the manuscript as per journal guidelines. The exciting and challenging part of the day would be you will be involved in Client servicing, Project management, and developmental activities for ensuring the smooth running of the process. This makes the position challenging and is ideal for those who are interested in continual learning and self-development in this role. Educational: Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Science & Arts (Physical Sciences/Engineering/Social Science) Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:

About us: Crimson Interactive: We are a technology-driven scientific communications & localization company. Crimson offers a robust ecosystem of services with cutting-edge AI and learning products for researchers, publishers, societies, universities, and government research bodies worldwide. With a global presence, including 9 international offices, we cater to the communication needs of the scientific community and corporates. What’s in it for you?
1. Global exposure: Crimson has employees belonging to more than 125 countries. Opportunity wot work with different Talent with different expertise and backgrounds under one roof. There is always something new to do and something challenging to work on. Hard work, perseverance, and the eagerness to learn are all that our Crimsonites need to flourish at Crimson!
2. Growth & Benefits: Growth to us is learning something new every day. We not only provide role-specific grooming and training but also various opportunities and platforms for our people to develop their skill and personalities, personally and professionally
3. Culture & Diversity: Our team comprises Fresher’s and experienced professionals from India, Japan, Taiwan, Korea, China, USA, UK, Colombia, Italy, Kazakhstan, etc. Crimson’s culture helps each one feel a valuable part of a bigger team, while retaining their individual beliefs and culture.
4. Our Ideologies, Our Beliefs: To us, growth is synonymous with progression, and our efforts are kindled to offer empowerment and flexibility to each one of us to share, learn, and grow. Our programs and culture assure our Crimsonites of all elements required to build a strong and successful long-term career. In all that we offer to our Crimsonites, there are four main ideologies and beliefs that form the framework to the benefits we provide

- Project Management JOB DESCRIPTION Job Title: Manager Project Management Department: Special Projects Job location: Goregaon (west), Mumbai Shift timings: 10 AM
- 7 PM Reporting: Sr. Manager
- Special Projects Crimson is looking for an experienced Manager
- Project Management with excellent team, people, and project management skills to define strategies as well as handle a highly dynamic team of project consultants. Come, be part of an organization that believes in constant employee engagement, professional growth, and superlative appreciation for the deserving candidates. Analyze all key metrics available in BI and work on action plans to improve performance. Strategy & Innovation Strategic collaboration with the internal teams to devise next steps on the overall quality & delivery aspect Hear the voice of client & take steps to improve existing products/processes to enhance client experience Formulation & implementation of business strategies to achieve set goals. Training & Development Provide process & product related training to the team ensuring to embed the cultural aspect & client behavior for the respective geography. Mentor & coach team members to assist them deliver as per expected standards. Ensure the team is updated with the industry knowledge. Work Management Ensuring the team productivity should be as per the set expectations. Analyzing team occupancy and planning for resource alignment. Performance Management Conduct regular performance reviews & provide developmental feedback to the team members. Identify High Potential Employees and also propose & implement succession planning. Provide & map career progression within the team. Key Requirements and characteristics: Minimum 8 years of experience in any of the following domains: Project management, Client servicing, Client experience or Account Management. Graduate from a reputed institute. MBA preferred, but not mandatory. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. jobDescription:
Academic Editor
- Chemistry, Engineering & Physical Sciences. Job Title: Academic Editor Location: Flexible/Remote Department: Editing Crimson Interactive is a leading language solutions provider in the field of diversified language solutions. We specialize in providing scientific and academic editing services to researchers to help them get published in high-impact factor journals globally. We aim to get everyone to read the how-when-what-where-why of ideas that can change the world. We are looking for Academic Editors in the fields of Physical Sciences, and Engineering. As an Academic Editor, you will edit and double-check manuscripts to ensure error-free output in order to meet international standards of publication. What is in it for you? Exposure: Global exposure to numerous research manuscripts written by authors that will keep you updated with information in your subject area. You will also be exposed to international publishing standards and norms in the industry. Growth and Self-development: You will be trained to become excellent at editing and reviewing research manuscripts. Exposure to conferences and international certifications like BELS will help you grow both professionally and personally. - 9 hours Job Description: Proofread manuscripts to ensure an error-free output to meet international standards of publication Proofreading does not merely involve casting a glance over what you have written. title: Quality Analyst - Physical Science and Engineering(Ulatus)
jobDescription:
Job title: Quality Analyst
- Physical Sciences and Engineering Brand: Ulatus
- Crimson Interactive Pvt. Ltd. Location: Remote This opening is for an individual who is passionate about working with language and finds grammar concepts to be challenging and fun. An individual who would like to understand the different nuances in a language better and is enthusiastic about learning and keeping themselves updated about the language industry. If you are that individual who cannot stand incorrect punctuation in a statement and know-how perfection in is achieved, well this will serve as the right opportunity to quench your thirst and fulfill your ambition. We offer you a platform with excellent brand names, top-notch visibility in the academic publishing industry, and an opportunity to learn as you work and grow with us professionally. Be part of an organization that believes in constant employee engagement, talent-based growth, an open-door policy, and superlative appreciation for high performers. Job Description The summary of your role is as follows: Check, track, improve, and manage the quality of freelance (FL) translators and checkers. Work in collaboration with various teams, Project Management (PM) and Client Servicing (CS) teams to understand and efficiently handle client consultations and requirements, as well as FL queries and concerns. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Responsible for Ulatus translation quality with respect to language, fluency, and grammar of the English language. Live and retrospective assignment audit and correction. Provide inputs and next steps in collaboration with the team manager on assignment quality issues. Monitoring and evaluating the quality of freelance translators and checkers. Improve translation quality through regular feedback, coaching, and training of freelance translators and checkers. Involvement in translation and new service consultations. (document/translator quality, subject area validation, freelancer translator/checkers profiles, new clients/processes) Monitor and audit “Trial” and “Special” projects. Maintain strong relationships with contract translators, editors, and proofreaders. Investigate client complaints regarding translation
- holding both freelance and full-time employees accountable. Identifying potential risk areas and creating action plans to mitigate the risks. Perform other special projects or duties when required. Work Experience and Skill Requirement : Superior language communication skills and the ability to explain language concepts to the translation team. Ability to multitask and demonstrate urgency and drive. Excellent problem-solving skills. Must be a team player. Excellent time management skills and the ability to work in a deadline-driven environment are essential. Proficiency in MS Office. Preferred Skills Requirement: Minimum 1 year of experience in editing/copy editing or 1-year conducting quality reviews/audits. Technically strong command on English language skills Published scholarly papers in academic journals. Ability to follow a publication’s guidelines (style manual, handbook, etc.) Good online search and information verification skills. Prior academic editing experience. Ability to take on responsibilities beyond a defined role. Knowledge of the STM industry. Qualification:- B.Tech/ M.Tech/ MSC/PHD
- Physical Science and Engineering, below mentioned subject area Physics Chemistry Mathematics Geology Astronomy Information Science Computer Science Electrical Engineering Electronics Engineering Chemical Engineering Mechanical Engineering Civil Engineering Telecommunication
